opportunities.title: Fulbright All Disciplines Scholar Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based academics and other professionals. Non-UK citizens apply through their country of citizenship; those ineligible to do so and committed to a career in the UK may be considered. Preference given to applicants without extensive (6+ months) prior US experience.
opportunities.summary: Lecture and/or research in any discipline at any accredited US university, as part of the Fulbright Visiting Scholar programme. Grant periods typically 3-6 months with generous monthly stipends, sickness/accident cover, visa and logistical support.

opportunities.title: Fulbright Elon University Award

amount.raw: Stipend: $5,000 per month; housing provided (private bedroom in The Isley International House); full-time faculty equivalent support

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based academics and professionals. Non-UK citizens apply through country of citizenship; those committed to a career in the UK may be considered.
opportunities.summary: Allows academics and professionals to teach and pursue independent research in any subject area offered by Elon University, with access to full faculty resources.

opportunities.title: Fulbright Royal College of Surgeons of England Award

amount.raw: £2,275 per month (converted to dollars) plus a further RCS grant covering basic NHS salary costs up to the maximum of the resident doctor pay scale for up to 6 months

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK trainee Royal College of Surgeons of England members.
opportunities.summary: Allows UK trainee RCS England members to pursue research into a number of surgical areas at any accredited US higher education institution, for up to 6 months.

opportunities.title: Fulbright Rutgers University-Newark Award

amount.raw: Stipend $5,000 per month for one semester (4 months); housing provided within the Honors Living Learning Community; travel grant up to £1,500

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based academics and professionals. Non-UK citizens apply through country of citizenship; those committed to a career in the UK may be considered.
opportunities.summary: Supports one scholar to spend a semester as part of the Honors Living Learning Community, teaching and pursuing research on issues of the contemporary urban environment in any of the University's departments or schools.

opportunities.title: Fulbright Royal Society of Edinburgh Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based academics and professionals. Non-UK citizens apply through country of citizenship; those committed to a career in the UK may be considered.
opportunities.summary: Lecture and/or research in any discipline at an accredited US university, as part of the Fulbright Visiting Scholar programme.

opportunities.title: Fulbright-National Archives Heritage Science Fellowship

amount.raw: Stipend to cover living expenses, settling-in costs and professional development allowances; round-trip international travel; dependent allowance if applicable

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers and professionals. Non-UK citizens apply through country of citizenship; those committed to a career in the UK may be considered.
opportunities.summary: Fellowship of 5-12 months (beginning September 2027) for hands-on scientific research supporting the conservation and preservation of cultural and historic artifacts at the National Archives, with lab access to analytical instruments (XRF, FT-IR, GC/MS) and Fulbright network access.
